title: Benchmarking LLM-Based Investment Advisor Agents for Asset Allocation in the Chinese ETF Market: Overview of NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 4
abstract: arXiv:2603.22305v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) convert unstructured financial news into actionable trading strategies, yet standardized end-to-end benchmarks tailored for Chinese market remain scarce. We select common Chinese Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) as the investment universe and introduce CN-Buzz2Portfolio, the official benchmark of NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 4. Investment agents take daily trending Chinese financial news and historical ETF price-volume series as inputs to complete news filtering, news-to-ETF mapping and risk-controlled portfolio construction. To facilitate fair comparison, we provide a reproducible Compression--Perception--Allocation baseline compatible with mainstream LLMs. The task contains two ETF allocation tracks: Macro-Asset Allocation and Sector-Rotation Allocation. We adopt chronological data split across 2024--2026 to alleviate overfitting, with final rankings determined by out-of-sample Sharpe ratios on unseen test

translated_title: 面向中国ETF市场资产配置的基于大语言模型投资顾问智能体基准测试：NLPCC 2026 共享任务 4 概述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够将非结构化的金融新闻转化为可执行的投资交易策略，然而针对中国市场的标准化端到端基准测试仍然稀缺。我们选取常见的中国交易型开放式指数基金（ETF）作为投资标的，并推出了 CN-Buzz2Portfolio——NLPCC 2026 共享任务 4 的官方基准测试。投资智能体以每日热门中文金融新闻和 ETF 历史价量序列作为输入，完成新闻筛选、新闻到 ETF 的映射以及风险可控的投资组合构建。为便于公平比较，我们提供了一个兼容主流大语言模型、可复现的“压缩—感知—配置”基线方案。该任务包含两条 ETF 配置赛道：宏观资产配置与行业轮动配置。我们采用 2024 至 2026 年的时序数据划分方式以缓解过拟合问题，最终排名由模型在未见过的测试数据上的样本外夏普比率决定。
tldr: 本文推出了 CN-Buzz2Portfolio——NLPCC 2026 共享任务 4 的官方基准，首次为中国 ETF 市场提供了评估大语言模型投资智能体进行新闻筛选、新闻映射与风险控制型资产配置的标准化端到端测试平台。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CN-Buzz2Portfolio, the official benchmark of NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 4, providing the first standardized end-to-end benchmark for evaluating LLM-based investment agents performing news filtering, news-to-ETF mapping, and risk-controlled asset allocation in the Chinese ETF market.
